history.text: At Carnuntum, Emperor emeritus Diocletian confers with Galerius, Augustus of the East, and Maximianus, the recently returned former Augustus of the West, in an attempt to end the civil wars of the Tetrarchy.
history.title: Carnuntum
history.description: Ancient Roman military outpost in modern Austria
